build_YOLOXHead: build a YOLOXHead detection head with configurable num_classes, in_channels, and loss functions
forward_YOLOXHead: run the YOLOXHead forward pass on multi-level feature maps to get cls_scores, bbox_preds, and objectnesses
predict_by_feat_YOLOXHead: transform extracted feature outputs into bbox detection results with NMS post-processing
loss_by_feat_YOLOXHead: calculate classification, bbox, objectness, and L1 losses for YOLOXHead training
bbox_decode_YOLOXHead: decode regression deltas to bounding boxes in tl_x, tl_y, br_x, br_y format
